name: citegeist
description: Search, read, quote, cite and add papers in your citegeist research library.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to your citegeist library through the cg command. Claude can search papers, read them by printed page, save quote cards, write and link notes, and add papers. Papers that Claude adds land in the inbox of the citegeist app unless you ask for them to go straight into the library. The bundle needs the citegeist app or the cg command on this Mac.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search items, cards, notes and text blocks

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Metadata, sources, literature note and card count of one item

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read a converted document by printed page, section or block

tools.name: list_cards
tools.description: List quote cards by item, project, tag or text

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add a paper by DOI, arXiv ID, ISBN, PMID, URL, BibTeX or file path

tools.name: create_card
tools.description: Save a verbatim quote as a quote card

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a note

tools.name: link
tools.description: Add a typed link from a note to an item, card or note

tools.name: attach_file
tools.description: Attach a local PDF, HTML page or EPUB to an existing item and convert it

tools.name: trash_item

tools.name: create_project

tools.name: jobs_get

tools.name: edit_outline

tools.name: edit_plan_doc

tools.name: find_insights
